offloading.name: Policy offloading
offloading.policies_xml: <policies><inbound><rate-limit-by-key calls="20" renewal-period="60" counter-key="@(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-client-id", "anonymous"))" /><cache-lookup vary-by-developer="false" vary-by-developer-groups="false" caching-type="internal"><vary-by-header>Accept</vary-by-header><vary-by-query-parameter>run</vary-by-query-parameter></cache-lookup><set-header name="x-gateway-transform" exists-action="override"><value>applied</value></set-header></inbound><backend><forward-request /></backend><outbound><set-header name="x-pattern" exists-action="override"><value>offloading</value></set-header><cache-store duration="30" /></outbound><on-error /></policies>

aggregation.name: Aggregation send-request fan-out
aggregation.policies_xml:
<policies><inbound>
<choose>
<when condition="@(context.Request.Url.Query.GetValueOrDefault("fail", "") == "transport")"><send-request mode="new" response-variable-name="orders" timeout="5" ignore-error="false"><set-url>http://pattern-backends:1/api/orders</set-url><set-method>GET</set-method></send-request></when>
<when condition="@(context.Request.Url.Query.GetValueOrDefault("fail", "") == "true")"><send-request mode="new" response-variable-name="orders" timeout="5" ignore-error="false"><set-url>http://pattern-backends:8000/api/orders-fail</set-url><set-method>GET</set-method></send-request></when>
<otherwise><send-request mode="new" response-variable-name="orders" timeout="5" ignore-error="false"><set-url>http://pattern-backends:8000/api/orders</set-url><set-method>GET</set-method></send-request></otherwise>
</choose>
<send-request mode="new" response-variable-name="profile" timeout="5" ignore-error="false"><set-url>http://pattern-backends:8000/api/profile</set-url><set-method>GET</set-method></send-request>
<choose><when condition="@(((IResponse)context.Variables["orders"]).StatusCode != 200 || ((IResponse)context.Variables["profile"]).StatusCode != 200)"><return-response><set-status code="502" reason="Bad Gateway" /><set-body>aggregation source returned an error</set-body></return-response></when></choose>
<return-response><set-status code="200" reason="OK" /><set-header name="content-type" exists-action="override"><value>application/json</value></set-header><set-header name="x-aggregation" exists-action="override"><value>orders,profile</value></set-header><set-body>@("{\"orders\":" + ((IResponse)context.Variables["orders"]).Body.As<string>(true) + ",\"profile\":" + ((IResponse)context.Variables["profile"]).Body.As<string>(true) + "}")</set-body></return-response>
</inbound><backend><forward-request /></backend><outbound /><on-error><return-response><set-status code="502" reason="Bad Gateway" /><set-body>aggregation callout failed</set-body></return-response></on-error></policies>
